The '''Yllotat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] waged a [[Prelude to Endor|campaign]] against the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|spy network]] responsible for leaking information about the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in this system.

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yllotat is an anagram for the word "totally". When combined with the system name from the previous TIE Fighter campaign ("Semag"), the company name [[Totally Games]] can be rendered.
